# India Standards

> Evidence-bounded demographic standards calculator using aggregate Indian survey data.

## When to use this

- Answering questions about average Indian demographic measurements (income, education, employment) with explicit uncertainty ranges
- Providing evidence-bounded estimates from PLFS aggregate survey data without overclaiming causality
- Comparing an individual's standing against survey-derived population distributions
- Redirecting requests for dating success, attractiveness, caste, or substance-use predictions (not supported by design)
